name: demon_vathrael
speaker: Vathrael
notes: Talking to VATHRAEL while he is CONTAINED (docs/PLAN_demons.md D6; game/demon_talk.h). Same engine flags as Skerrick's (demon:present, demon:bound) and the same {tell} {name} {margin} {weight} {contract}. The QUEST HOOK is a stub: he names a task (the bell of the drowned chapel) and, if you listen, sets the world flag quest:vathrael_bell = 1; nothing reads it yet. Releasing him is the fight: his power is past any circle you can draw, and his tells say so.

nodes.text: The thing in the salt is taller than the cellar wants it to be. It folds itself down to look at you and smiles with too many teeth. "{tell}"

choices.text: I have a contract for you.
Go back where you came from.

nodes.text: "Want? A bell. Under the drowned chapel past the marsh, a bell that was rung once to bind something like me. Bring me its tongue and I will teach you the names your smith never learned."
"The bell, summoner. The chapel, the marsh, the tongue." He studies your salt as if it were writing. "{tell}"

choices.text: I have a contract for you.
Go back where you came from.

nodes.text: He does not take the page. He reads it where you hold it, and the ink curls.
The page blackens from the edges in. "{tell}"

choices.text: Go back where you came from.

nodes.text: "You may. Look at your circle first, and then at me." {tell}
